description: S46 T3 registers T5/T8's code early (contract-first, beside server-add-no-actor.json): mcp.server.remove — the human write door at T5 — refuses to remove a server agents still DECLARE with ErrMcpInUse (-31855), naming the declaring agents in `what` so the operator's next call is informed.
